description: Full documentation for remote-store: tutorials, how-to guides, API reference, and design explanations. Write file storage code once, run it against local files, S3, SFTP, or Azure.
rules: Docs follow the Diataxis framework: /stable/tutorial/ for learning by doing, /stable/guides/ for task-focused how-tos, /stable/reference/ for API reference, /stable/explanation/ for architecture and design rationale.

Use Store.read(path) for streaming reads, Store.write(path, content) for streaming writes (returns WriteResult), and Store.list_files(path) for directory listings. All backends share this interface — swap config only, not code.

Backends declare capabilities (LAZY_READ, ATOMIC_WRITE, ATOMIC_MOVE, METADATA, GLOB, …). Query store.supports(Capability.X) before calling a capability-gated method. The full capability matrix is at /stable/reference/features/.
Backends are swapped by config alone — same Store API calls, different backend= argument or Registry entry. Available backends and required pip extras are at /stable/reference/features/.

For async workloads, import AsyncStore from remote_store.aio. To cross the sync/async boundary, use SyncBackendAdapter (sync Backend in async code) or AsyncBackendSyncAdapter (async Backend in sync code). See /stable/guides/async-sync-bridges/.
Streaming reads: with store.read(path) as f: data = f.read(). Atomic writes: with store.open_atomic(path) as f: f.write(...). The destination file appears only after the block exits cleanly.

Errors are typed in remote_store.errors (re-exported from remote_store). SDK exceptions never leak through the Store API. Catch specific subclasses: NotFound, AlreadyExists, PermissionDenied, CapabilityNotSupported, BackendUnavailable.
Configuration loads from TOML, YAML, dict, or Pydantic models via Registry. ${ENV_VAR} placeholders are resolved and credentials are wrapped in Secret automatically.
Write methods return WriteResult(path, size, digest, etag, last_modified, metadata). Rich fields require WRITE_RESULT_NATIVE capability. store.head(path) returns metadata without reading content.

Extensions augment the Store API without backend changes — composable batching, caching, integrity, and streaming helpers are always available. Optional extras add PyArrow, OpenTelemetry, Pydantic, YAML, and Dagster. See /stable/guides/extensions/.
